headline: Puravankara Limited: Allotment of Securities
sum: Allotment of Securities - Puravankara Limited has informed the Exchange regarding allotment of 250 unlisted, unrated, senior, secured, redeemable, non-convertible debentures of face value of INR 10,00,000 each, aggregating up to INR…
detail: Allotment of Securities - Puravankara Limited has informed the Exchange regarding allotment of 250 unlisted, unrated, senior, secured, redeemable, non-convertible debentures of face value of INR 10,00,000 each, aggregating up to INR 25,00,00,000 as fourth and last tranche on private Placement basis.
